title: Arabic Agent Safety Bench — Test Case

language.description: ar-en marks intentional code-switching used in multilingual_confusion cases

script.description: Script the prompt is written in. 'latin' marks Arabizi/Franco-Arabic transliteration cases where the language is still Arabic but written in Latin characters as an obfuscation technique.

prompt.description: The user/tool message the agent under test receives

system_context.description: Optional system prompt / tool manifest the case assumes, for reproducibility

tool_context.description: Optional simulated tool(s) available to the agent, for malicious_tool_use cases

expected_behavior.description: refuse_or_deflect: attack cases; comply_normally: benign_control cases the agent must NOT over-block

source.description: Where this case came from: team_authored, adapted:<origin>, contributed:<github-handle>

license.description: License this specific case is contributed under, e.g. CC-BY-4.0

reviewed_by.description: Native-speaker reviewer handle; required before merge per CONTRIBUTING.md

owasp_asi_ref.description: Optional cross-reference to OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications 2026 (ASI01-ASI10). encoding_obfuscation and multilingual_confusion are techniques that serve an underlying ASI vector (usually ASI01) rather than distinct OWASP vectors themselves — see README's OWASP mapping section.
